name: Sliding Window Guidance (SWG)
plain: An extra positive pass is run on overlapping tiles, not the whole latent, so the model sees less context. The difference from the whole-image prediction becomes guidance. Tile sizes are in pixels divided by 8. The cost is one model call per tile.
math:
For each tile T: x̂_T = M(x|T; c), accumulated and divided by overlap count = x̂_w
x̂ = x̂_cfg + w·(x̂_c − x̂_w)

props.params: scale=5.0, tile_width=768, tile_height=768, tile_overlap=256, sigma_start=-1, sigma_end=5.42

label: from code
surprise: The window step uses tile_width·i..tile_width·(i+1)+overlap, while tile count uses width−overlap, so the extra tiles past the edge are empty and skipped; overlap is less than the count suggests.
